items.note: A compact yolk header band with a small sag, an h2 title and one line of copy, and a storefront cluster in the trailing corner. Below it come dot filter pills on ledges, then cream cards with full-strength category covers holding crescent-shaded pictograms that fill their boxes. The rc.4 gap of the art-sized, half-empty band has closed: the grid starts at about y≈440, and the band reads like the reference's short, confident fields (02/04 scale).

The band is text-sized and its cluster sits 96px in the top corner, as in reference 04, so the rc.4 phone stacking gap has closed. Filter pills wrap cleanly. The catalog then becomes one full-width square saturated cover per card, so the scroll is a stack of big colour slabs, one product per screen, which is coarser than the reference's compact phone rhythm.

Navy page with a yellow header band, a white selected pill and indigo filter pills and cards. It carries the night palette of 03 convincingly and the covers keep their full hues. At the bottom, the footer ends in a bright white bar under the indigo footer: the only light surface on the night page.

The same compact yolk band with the corner cluster on navy. The white selected pill and the indigo pills and sort select keep their ledges. Type and spacing match the light version, and it reads like the reference's derived night palette.

The cream header band (correct with a large cover following) holds a breadcrumb, an h2 title, the price and a tag cluster. A big yellow cover with the tote pictogram sits beside the tag, description, bordered colour tiles, a circle stepper and the blue add-to-cart pill, all in the first viewport. The structure and pills are close to the reference, but the last colour tile's label runs into its right border.

A compact cream band with a 96px corner cluster, then a full-width cover right after the title, per the spec's priority rule. The band art is the same price tag scene used on every item page with only its hues swapped, so it pictures the price rather than this item. The reference gives each spot its own subject (07).

An indigo header band on navy, a white-ringed selected tile, indigo choice tiles and circle stepper, and the blue pill. A clean night translation of the light page and close to 03's tone, but the colour tile label still collides with its tile edge.
An indigo compact band with white title and price, the corner tag cluster and a full-width yellow cover below. On navy it holds hierarchy and contrast as well as the light version does.

Same layout as the tote page with a blue cover and a well-drawn yellow sweater pictogram. The size tiles pair each radio with an identical blue target disc that means nothing, a doubled marker. The reference's choice rows (05/10) set one meaningful glyph beside a bold label.
The compact cream band wraps the breadcrumb and a two-line title cleanly beside the corner tag cluster, with the blue cover right after. Rhythm and type scale are close to reference 04.
Indigo band, blue cover and indigo size tiles on navy: a solid night version. The band cluster is again the price tag, recoloured blue, identical in arrangement to every other item page.
The night compact band with white type and the tag cluster, then the blue cover with the sweater pictogram. Spacing and hierarchy match the light phone screen and the reference's night tone.

A compact blue header band in the cart area's hue with a basket cluster (lead, second-hue disc, star, cloud), then a cream radius.xl empty-state panel. The panel is cream because a field is in view, as the spec says, and holds a bag composition, an h4 title, one line and an ink pill. Close to the reference's panel craft (09).

The blue band keeps to its text with the basket tucked in the corner. The cream empty panel holds a large bag composition, a bold title and a full ink pill on its ledge. Well-paced and clearly the reference's language.
A blue band on navy with an indigo empty panel and a white pill, which turns the cream-panel recipe into the night palette the way 03 does. Hierarchy is as clear as in light mode.
Blue compact band, indigo empty panel with a pink bag and yellow disc composition, and a white pill. The footer's rise arc is visible in indigo below. A convincing night phone screen.

findings.summary: In dark mode the footer still ends in a bright white bottom bar under the indigo footer, the only light surface on a night page. The reference's night palette stays dark to the edge (03). This was named in rc.3 and rc.4 and has not closed, because the spec still maps the bar to `surface.inverse`, which is white at night.
findings.promptFix: Give the footer bottom bar its own role token, the darkest surface in both appearances: ink by day, and a step darker than the navy page at night, both with white text and icons. Keep `surface.inverse` for small floating pieces such as toasts.
findings.specRule: Footer | Cream band with rise arc, link columns, a signup field + ink pill; `surface.inverse` bottom bar with round icon buttons … (dark) `color.surface.inverse` | `#ffffff`

findings.summary: Every item detail page uses the same header-band cluster (a price tag with a disc, sparkles and a string), with only the hues swapped. It pictures the price rather than the item, and it repeats across the area. The reference gives each spot its own nameable subject (07), and the spec asks for no two clusters alike.

The size choice tiles pair each radio with an identical blue target disc that carries no meaning, so every option shows two markers and the labels read weakly. The reference's choice rows (05, 10) put one meaningful glyph beside a bold label.

On phones the catalog turns every card into a full-width square saturated cover, so the scroll becomes one product per screen and a run of big colour slabs, often two in view at once. The reference's phone keeps colour fields compact and spaced between white and cream (04).
In the colour choice tiles on the item page, the last option's label runs into the tile's right border with no inner padding. This is the agent's sizing slip, not a spec rule.
